ESP32-CAM sends 'S<ms>,<cat>\n' over SoftwareSerial to the Nano, where <ms> is spray_time_s from the Flask API converted to milliseconds; the Nano actuates the relay for that duration directly rather than recomputing it from the category code, so the per-disease factor in severity.py is not lost

hardware_implementation_plan.md section 6.1 places the trigger button on ESP32-CAM GPIO0, but GPIO0 is wired to the camera module's XCLK line on every AI-Thinker ESP32-CAM board and cannot be used as a free input while the camera runs; the firmware and Chapter 5 move the button to GPIO16
